mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot as app_main
  participant App as app_start
  participant DHT as dht22_task
  participant IMU as mpu6050_task
  participant Net as network_service_task
  participant WiFi as WiFi station
  participant MQTT as MQTT broker transport
  participant Diag as diagnostics_task
  participant UART as Console UART
  Boot->>Boot: firmgen_telemetry_start
  Boot->>Boot: firmgen_proto_monitor_start
  Boot->>App: app_start
  App->>DHT: osal_task_create
  App->>IMU: osal_task_create
  App->>Net: osal_task_create
  App->>Diag: diagnostics_service_start
  DHT->>DHT: gpio_config on GPIO 2
  DHT->>DHT: Read and decode DHT22 frame
  IMU->>IMU: Configure I2C GPIO 9 and GPIO 8
  IMU->>IMU: Probe address 0x68 and read acceleration
  Net->>Net: Initialize NVS and load thresholds
  Net->>WiFi: esp_wifi_start
  WiFi-->>Net: IP_EVENT_STA_GOT_IP
  Net->>MQTT: esp_mqtt_client_start
  loop DHT22 every 2000 ms
    DHT->>DHT: Sample climate data
  end
  loop MPU6050 every 100 ms
    IMU->>IMU: Read motion state
  end
  loop Network service runtime
    Net->>Net: Read climate and motion snapshots
    alt Both samples are valid
      Net->>MQTT: Publish vehicle/cabin/telemetry
      Net->>Net: Evaluate configured thresholds
      alt Threshold is crossed
        Net->>MQTT: Publish vehicle/cabin/alert
      end
    end
    alt WiFi retry bit is set
      Net->>WiFi: esp_wifi_connect
    end
  end
  loop Diagnostics command polling
    Diag->>Diag: xQueueReceive for 250 ms
    alt Command is question mark
      Diag->>UART: ESP_LOGI HEALTH counters
    else Unknown command
      Diag->>UART: ESP_LOGW unknown diagnostics command
    end
  end
  loop Firmgen emitters every 500 ms
    Boot->>UART: RTOS and protocol JSON telemetry
  end
title: Sequence Diagram
